p_instr.cores: each physical core, P and E separately; one pinned worker at a time
p_instr.operands: loaded into YMM registers before timing; AVX2 activation signed-word values reflect sign-extended INT8, weights signed-word values in [-7,+7]; no Q4 decode, scale conversion, weight loads, or external reduction in timed loop

p_q4.weights: one deterministic matrix per physical core; reused across m and both ISA routes; 147456 B payload, expected resident in observed 2 MiB P-core L2 / 4 MiB E-cluster L2; prewarmed by 5 warmup samples
p_q4.activations: deterministic INT8 + FP32 group scales generated separately for each m
p_q4.timed_region: 32 calls to the current full Q4 execute_into_prechecked operator; includes its decode, scale handling, accumulation, and result-buffer work

series_order.p_instr: P-core physical_core_api_key ascending, then E-core ascending; per core AVX2 then AVX-VNNI-256
series_order.p_q4: P-core physical_core_api_key ascending, then E-core ascending; per core AVX2 then AVX-VNNI-256; m ascending within each route

outputs: results/T0.0/phase0_raw/p_instr_raw.csv, p_instr_summary.csv, p_q4_m_raw.csv, p_q4_m_summary.csv; derived peak/eta tables generated only after both families complete
